content.title: Raised blood pressure estimate
content.body: Your blood pressure was estimated at 128/84 mmHg with a heart rate of around 72 bpm. A normal range sits below 120 over 80. This is a screening signal and not a diagnosis. Please see a doctor within 7 days. Reply to kunal.j.patient@example.com if you need the report resent.
recommendations: Book a cuff check within 7 days.
Repeat the scan each morning for a week.
